title: A refusal from any command
description: The shape of every answer the agent gives when it will not do the thing at all: a bad argument, an unknown service, a configuration it cannot trust, a restricted session. There is always a reasonCode and always a message, because a client renders by code and falls back to prose.

argument.description: The option or positional the refusal is about, when it is about one.

accepts.description: What would have been accepted instead. The known service ids for unknown-service, the boot targets for unknown-target, the flags for bad-argument.

problems.description: config-invalid only: exactly why the configuration was refused, one entry per problem.

error.description: The 2.x key for the same sentence as `message`. Kept so a 2.x client still shows something.
